candidates.change_summary: Change proxiableUUID to return a different storage slot constant (replace IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT with ADMIN_SLOT).
Modify notDelegated to invert the proxy check so it returns normally when delegated and reverts otherwise, affecting notDelegated guard on proxiableUUID.
Replace the body of C.initialize so it does not call __UUPSUpgradeable_init(), changing initialization side-effects.
Change the initializer modifier to avoid setting _initialized to 1, leaving contract as uninitialized after initialize() returns.

When computing utilization from index and elapsed, use multiplication before division (change (index - utilizationData.index) / elapsed to (index - utilizationData.index) * 1e27 / elapsed and adjust subsequent math by removing extra division), causing a different computed utilization when (index - index) not divisible by elapsed.
When elapsed equals block.timestamp, use zero utilization instead of reading IVault.utilization, changing returned rate in that edge condition.

If block.timestamp is not greater than lastUpdate, call currentUtilizationIndex and compute utilization from index difference instead of reading IVault.utilization, altering returned rate for that branch.
Replace the kink validation to allow kink == 0 but still reject >= 1e27, changing accepted slopes and thus stored state after setSlopes.
Change validation to reject only kink == 0 (allowing >=1e27), permitting storing slopes with very large kink values which alters observable stored slopes.
Remove the kink validation entirely so any kink value (including 0 and >=1e27) is stored, changing post-call state.
Invert the validation to accept only slopes with kink >= 1e27 or kink == 0, rejecting the previously valid middle range and changing stored slopes.
After validation, modify the stored slopes to set slope0 to zero before storing, changing observable stored values after setSlopes.
